_why: The auto-picker snaps to the nearest cut at 38% duration, which is right most of the time and wrong in ways only a person can see: it cannot tell that a frame carries burned-in lyric captions, or that a better shot exists elsewhere. Overrides are per-id, with the reason, so the choice is reproducible rather than a hand-edit someone finds later and cannot explain.

_crop: Per-clip crop, as a fraction of height kept from the top. The default 0.87 clears most burned-in caption bands and baked letterboxing. 'Peace' is a lyric video whose captions sit higher than the default clears, and one of them carries profanity — a panel on the artist's own site must not ship someone else's caption track.
_len: Per-clip length. Only set when a clip must END before something enters frame.
